mapper.sql: id AS subscription_id, creator_id, member_id, customer_key, billing_key, price, start_date, end_date, status, next_billing_at

s.id AS subscription_id, m.name AS name, m.unique_id AS unique_id, m.email AS email, s.price AS price, s.status AS status, s.start_date AS start_date, s.end_date AS end_date, s.next_billing_at AS next_billing_at

s.id AS subscription_id, s.member_id AS member_id, s.creator_id AS creator_id, m.name AS creator_name, m.unique_id AS creator_unique_id, m.profile_image AS profile_image, m.introduction AS introduction, s.status AS status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscription ( creator_id, member_id, customer_key, billing_key, price, status ) VALUES ( #{creatorId}, #{memberId}, #{customerKey}, #{billingKey}, #{price}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE subscription SET billing_key = NULL, end_date = next_billing_at, status = "CANCELED", next_billing_at = NULL WHERE id = #{subscriptionId}
UPDATE subscription SET billing_key = NULL, end_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = "REMOVED", next_billing_at = NULL WHERE id = #{subscriptionId}
UPDATE subscription SET status = "REMOVED", next_billing_at = NULL WHERE end_date < NOW() AND status = "CANCELED";
mapper.select: SELECT FROM subscription as s WHERE next_billing_at < NOW() AND billing_key != NULL
SELECT FROM subscription as s JOIN member m ON m.id = s.creator_id WHERE s.id = #{subscriptionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM subscription WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status != "REMOVED"
